## E — Market signal

Status: no market research was performed for this section; the upstream competitive-intelligence pointer was not supplied for this run, so market size, pass rate, rooms, voice-of-customer quotes, persona, seasonality, price and success bar are recorded as typed debt (verify — CT-SEC-TWO-E-MARKET).
Known context only from the product frame: buyers are first-time Connecticut applicants and the parents of teen drivers preparing for the knowledge test; for this section the pressing need is knowing the road test steps, the teen passenger and curfew limits, and the donor, voter and disability options.
Ad hooks, verbatim learner pain phrases and a named differentiation gap must come from sourced recon in a later pass, never invented here.
